name: Five Tribes
metaTitle: Five Tribes Score Calculator (Viziers, Djinns & Merchandise)
metaDescription: Free Five Tribes score calculator for 2–4 players. Adds coins, viziers and their bonus, elders, djinns, palm trees, palaces, tiles and merchandise sets.
intro: Five Tribes has eight different sources of points, and the vizier bonus depends on your opponents. Enter what each player owns and the calculator adds it all up.

categories.label: Viziers (yellow)
categories.help: 1 point for each Vizier you own.

categories.label: Vizier bonus
categories.help: Count the opponents who have strictly fewer Viziers than you. Each is worth 10 points.

categories.label: Elders (white)
categories.help: 2 points for each Elder you own.

categories.label: Djinns
categories.help: Add the points printed on your Djinns.

categories.label: Palm trees
categories.help: 3 points for each palm tree on tiles with your camel.

categories.label: Palaces
categories.help: 5 points for each palace on tiles with your camel.

categories.label: Tiles
categories.help: Add the point values of every tile with one of your camels.

categories.label: Merchandise: first set
categories.help: Count the different merchandise cards in a set (Fakirs don't count).

categories.label: Merchandise: second set
categories.help: Duplicates start another set, scored the same way.

categories.label: Merchandise: third set
categories.help: Only if you have three or more of one kind.

tiebreaker: The rules do not separate tied players: they share the victory (or play again).

rules.heading: How Five Tribes is scored
body: When the game ends, each player adds up their coins, meeples, djinns, tiles and merchandise. Every gold coin is worth 1 point. Each Vizier is worth 1 point and each Elder 2 points.
Viziers also give a big bonus: 10 points for each opponent who has strictly fewer Viziers than you. In a 4-player game, owning the most Viziers outright is worth 30 bonus points.

rules.heading: Your tiles
body: Every tile with one of your camels on it scores its printed value. On top of that, each palm tree on your tiles scores 3 points and each palace scores 5. Djinns score the points printed on them.

rules.heading: Merchandise sets
body: Split your merchandise cards into sets where every card is different. Fakirs are not merchandise and never count. A set of 1 to 9 different cards scores 1, 3, 7, 13, 21, 30, 40, 50 or 60 points. Duplicates start a new set that is scored the same way.

faq.q: How does the Vizier bonus work in Five Tribes?
faq.a: You score 10 points for every opponent who has strictly fewer Viziers than you. Ties with an opponent give no bonus for that opponent.
Not as merchandise. They are only spent to use some Djinns' powers.
1, 3, 7, 13, 21, 30, 40, 50 or 60 points for 1 to 9 different cards.
